newsitem.title: PORTUGAL: FORECAST - Bank/Portugal to leave rates unchanged.
newsitem.headline: FORECAST - Bank/Portugal to leave rates unchanged.

text.p: The Bank of Portugal is expected to leave its money market rates unchanged on Monday when it announces conditions for the next commercial bank reserve period, analysts and traders said.

They said the slight easiness of the escudo on Monday together with uncertainty over inflation would deter the Bank from making any change to its repo rate or its draining rate when it announces the conditions in the afternoon.
The repo rate stands at 7.0 percent, while the draining rate stands at 6.8 percent.

"I expect the Bank to cut the drain rate to 6.50 by the end of the year because it has room, but today I don't think it will do anything because it will want to wait for the inflation numbers," said one trader.
"With the escudo slipping...it is not a good moment," said another.
After opening steady at 101.19/21 to the mark, the currency slipped to 101.35 in early trade although there was no particular reason for the move, currency traders said.

The National Statistics Institute (INE) is expected to issue inflation figures for October this week. The rate stood at a 3.3 percent on the basis of the rolling 12-month average, the government benchmark, in September, unchanged from August.
